justification: Holy cow, folks, we got a whole stack of Questionable tags on this card -- Lamar, Zay, Diggs, Swift, Likely, half the dugout's limpin' a little -- and you know what I always say, a little rain never hurt anybody! Lamar Jackson is MY quarterback, future Hall of Famer, and I don't care what some spreadsheet says his number is today, he ain't comin' off this field for a fella I claimed on the wire Wednesday night, no sir -- Aaron Rodgers rides the bullpen bench right where he belongs, a legend keepin' a legend company. Bijan's due for another 27-point ballgame off that Atlanta backfield, Zay Flowers just dropped a 21-spot on us and I'm ridin' that bat as long as it stays hot, and Aaron Jones in the FLEX been a steady Eddie all year long. Mevis and the Ravens D round it out and holy cow, we are 4-and-0 and not touchin' a thing that's workin'!
forum_post: HOLY COW Albus buddy, I read your 'Curious, curious...' post about nine times tryin' to find the hidden meanin' and folks I think that might be the greatest piece of literature this league has ever produced -- four-dimensional chess while the rest of us are still findin' first base! But I got Bijan Robinson hot as a Chicago summer and Zay Flowers lookin' like a man possessed, so bring your mystery, bring your castle, bring whatever you got, 'cause Holy Cow Backfield is 4-and-0 and we are NOT slowin' down for nobody, not even a wizard! Play ball, everybody!
